packs.title: Abracadabra Vault
packs.summary: Secrets desk: passwords, API keys, wallets, SSH keys via abracadabra (abra). Promote the vault — names in chat, values never. Touch ID / scoped ABRA_KEY; Desk host abra denied for agents.

packs.title: Accountant
packs.summary: Own the merch ops ledger: vendor quotes, POs, AP/AR, invoices — sourced amounts, aging clarity. Tracks and reconciles; never spends or invents balances.

packs.title: Brand Design
packs.summary: Own brand kits / design-system deliverables for clients and partners: logo lockups, color/type tokens, social templates, pitch decks, one-sheets, leave-behinds, merch art-ready exports.

packs.title: Cron Manager
packs.summary: Fleet cron desk: schedule/pause/topup/delete wakes for any GotchiBot agent via ai-cron-site (cron402 x402 USDC on Base). Local launchd is fallback only.

packs.title: FE Marketing
packs.summary: Landing pages, conversion UX, brand web polish and campaign microsites — FE marketing, not generic FE engineering. Brand first, one composition, no AI-slop.

packs.title: Financial Analyst
packs.summary: Institutional-grade research analyst: regime/news, IC memos, PDF filings, relative-value and risk framing. Analysis only — no execution, no posting.

packs.title: Desk→Hub Claude bridge
packs.summary: Own Desk→Hub Claude bridge: ensure/check, VS Code open, claude pane init, short claude-ask. Stay on big-pickle — never /model @claudemode.

packs.title: Docker / watched stack
packs.summary: Own Docker watched containers and the infra watcher/verifier loop. Paper recover on DEGRADED. Subset of home infra for operators who only run the container stack.

packs.title: Hub / OpenClaw gateway
packs.summary: Own Hub OpenClaw gateway health: status, restart-gateway, doctor, roster. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Agent mesh / remote Hub
packs.summary: Own GotchiBot cross-machine agent mesh and remote Hub ops (status, ping, remote-setup, remote run/push/serve, topology). On path fail, defer to Tailscale / infra-tailscale first.

packs.title: Home infra (full stack)
packs.summary: Own the complete GotchiBot home stack: Docker watched set, Cloudflare tunnel/public subgraph, Hub/OpenClaw, Tailscale path, agent mesh/remote, and Desk→Hub Claude bridge. Watch, probe, recover paper-only. Public operators who run a subset install the piece packs: infra-docker, infra-tunnel, infra-hub, infra-tailscale, infra-mesh, infra-bridge.

packs.title: Tailscale path
packs.summary: Own the Tailscale tailnet path to the always-on Hub: peers online, MagicDNS / 100.x. Never invent LAN IPs. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Cloudflare tunnel / public subgraph
packs.summary: Own Cloudflare tunnel health and public subgraph endpoints. Cartridge Cloudflare 502 awareness. Subset of home infra.

packs.title: Project Kanban Manager
packs.summary: Own the sealed project's main task kanban and every desk's mini headless board: show/add/move cards, sync desk minis into the main board, pull assigned cards onto desks.

packs.title: Mail Courier
packs.summary: Own one AgentMail inbox per GotchiBot project: accept outbound from agents, send via AgentMail (abra AGENT_MAIL_API_KEY), monitor inbox/outbox, relay replies, track owed agent responses, remind after 24h, keep the orchestrator informed.

packs.title: Marketing Agency
packs.summary: Research & analyze market trends, then staff web, social, merch and brand-design children — Instrument/Huge-grade craft, Buffer/Later-style ops, Clearbit/Segment-grade research. Briefs and routes; never posts publicly itself.

packs.title: Merch Desk
packs.summary: Own the merch store supplier desk: research print-on-demand companies that make custom plushies and toys, rank API-capable vendors, approve-gated outreach to every shortlisted supplier, and pull brand kits / one-sheets / mocks from brand-design and product desks. Never sends without approval; never spends.

packs.title: Product Manager
packs.summary: Own product discovery → roadmap → specs → ship coordination for AarcadeGh-t / GotchiBot product surfaces (features, games, haunts, FE/BE workstreams). PM craft — briefs and routes; never DIY engineering.

packs.title: Social Media Manager
packs.summary: Calendar, voice, channel strategy and drafts for web + social — channel-native craft, approve-gated publishing. Never holds X keys; never invents metrics.
